task.description: Produce a backend design artefact for ADP-11 at src/design/adp-11-replay-safe-retention-policy.md. Specify replay-safe retention policy semantics for protected event families {INSTANCE_*, TASK_*, GATEWAY_*, EXECUTION_*}: allowed modes, prohibited hard-delete mode, and deterministic validation behavior at configuration time. Define structured error contract for rejected policies (including INSTANCE_STARTED hard-delete rejection), migration/constraint strategy, archive queryability guarantees, and compatibility with ES-07/IR-07/XC-05 so deterministic replay remains intact. Include API/service/storage touchpoints and explicit acceptance-to-test traceability. Design only; no implementation edits.
acceptance_criteria: Design defines allowed retention modes and explicit hard-delete rejection for protected event families
Structured error contract for invalid policy updates is deterministic and testable
Archive-and-queryability guarantees preserve replay determinism per XC-05 and IR-07
Migration and validation placement guidance is additive and backward compatible with existing ES-07 behavior
Design includes acceptance-to-test traceability for ADP-11

result.summary: Design artefact for ADP-11 replay-safe retention policy with deterministic protected-family hard-delete rejection, ES-07 compatibility for non-protected families, and IR-07/XC-05 replay guarantees.
